company.description:
Made for motion – KTR has been developing power transmission components for mechanical and plant engineering under this slogan for more than fifty years. As a leading manufacturer of high-grade power transmission technology, brake systems and cooling systems, and hydraulic components, KTR is a dependable partner for any company that wishes to keep moving forward.

Facts and figures

At a glance: KTR is at home in industrial markets on all continents with over 460 employees at its headquarters in Rheine, more than 1,100 employees worldwide, 24 subsidiaries and over 90 sales partners.
    
KTR has been certified to ISO 9001:2015 since 1993 and to ISO ISO 14001:2015 since June 2008.
